source.relationship: Founder-affiliated. Owned and operated by a PandaCodeGen co-founder.
source.system: Custom operations platform built on Next.js, Sanity, Supabase and Square
source.method: Referrer captured where it survives; customer-declared discovery collected through the How did you find us question in the quote and CRM workflow. Both inputs feed the recorded source value. Customer-declared discovery is distinct from a captured referral click.
source.limitation: One business, one vertical (custom embroidered and printed patches), one window. These are not industry benchmarks and no claim is made that they generalise.

orderWindow.label: 1 March to 18 August 2026
orderWindow.note: Both totals exclude Web Checkout (48 orders, $10,295.11), which the Panda Patches operations platform treats as a fulfilment route rather than an acquisition source and already excludes from its own revenue total. Excluding it from the order count too keeps both figures describing the same population; mixing them was an error caught by summing the rows against the declared totals.

corroboration.instrument: Google Search Console, Performance, Generative AI features (Beta)
corroboration.note: A separate record of visibility in Google AI search features. It is not independent validation of the store's order-source attribution or revenue comparison.
corroboration.limitation: Impressions in Google's generative surfaces, not clicks, orders or revenue. They do not verify which assistant a customer used or the revenue attributed to it.

outlierDisclosure.note: Average order value of $6,120 against a site average of $357.40, almost certainly bulk or wholesale. Removing it moves the AI revenue share from 6.2% to 6.8%, so it works against the headline rather than for it.
